title: Private jet charter to and from Lagos
description: Private flights to and from Lagos: Murtala Muhammed International's terminal hours, from the Nigerian airport authority, and how we plan.
h1: Private flights to and from Lagos
lead: Lagos' Murtala Muhammed International is Nigeria's busiest gateway. What the official source says.

p: The airport has its {{dnmm.hours}}. The operator confirms the aerodrome hours, permits and handling for your flight.

Nigeria asks foreign operators for permission before a charter flight, and the operator books the handling at the airport. We check the airport's hours and services for your times with the operator before you see a quote, and we confirm them again before departure.

Every person travelling needs a valid passport and any visa the country asks for. The operator and its handling agent arrange customs, immigration and ground handling for your arrival and departure, and tell you where to meet the crew.

Your trip brief names the airport, where private flights are handled and the contact on the ground. Your broker stays with you from the first enquiry to the last landing, and follows up after the trip.

sections.h: How we plan a private flight to or from Lagos
p: Tell us where you are flying from or to, when, and how many people are travelling. We compare the airports around Lagos for your times and your aircraft, find aircraft from licensed operators, check each operator before you see a quote, and name the operator in your quote and agreement. Any aircraft, any route, upon availability.

Airport rules change at short notice. The operator and its handling agent confirm the current rules for your flight before departure; every fact on this page shows its source and the date we checked it.

faq.q: Does Archē Executive operate the flight?
faq.a: No. We are a broker. A licensed operator flies every trip, and it is named in your quote and charter agreement before you confirm.
